parameters.query: SELECT c.user_id, u.email, p.profile->>'name' as name, c.weight, c.data, c.date, p.profile->>'goalWeight' as goal_weight FROM public.checkins c JOIN auth.users u ON c.user_id = u.id JOIN public.user_profiles p ON c.user_id = p.user_id WHERE c.date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY c.user_id

parameters.name: messages
parameters.value: =[{"role":"user","content":"Analyze this weekly fitness check-in and write a 2-sentence personalized coaching message. Be direct, specific, and motivating. User: {{ $json.name }}. Weight: {{ $json.weight }} lbs (goal: {{ $json.goal_weight }} lbs). Sessions completed: {{ Object.values($json.data.workouts || {}).filter(v=>v).length }}/6. Energy: {{ $json.data.energy }}/5. Wellbeing: {{ $json.data.well }}/5. Reflection: {{ $json.data.hard }}. Improvement areas: {{ $json.data.improve }}. Response must be under 100 words, personal, no fluff."}]

parameters.query: INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, message, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $('For each check-in').item.json.user_id }}', 'coaching', '{{ $json.content[0].text }}', NOW())
